name: xenon-ui
description: Xenon terminal front-end. The kernel stays in Python; this only speaks the NDJSON protocol.

scripts.bundle: esbuild src/cli.tsx --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --legal-comments=none --alias:react-devtools-core=./src/shims/react-devtools-core.ts --banner:js="import { createRequire as __cr } from 'node:module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);" --outfile=dist/xenon-ui.js
scripts.build:release: npm run build && npm run bundle
